issue.title: [ES|QL] Allow DateTime as the third and fourth inputs to auto_bucket

labels.name: Team:Analytics
labels.description: Meta label for analytical engine team (ESQL/Aggs/Geo)

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
Resolves: #102756 #104646 

Currently, the AUTO_BUCKET function takes only String data type for the start and end time range. This enhances the AUTO_BUCKET function by allowing data with DateTime type as input to the start and end time range, users do not need to convert the input parameters from DateTime to String type manually.

The AUTO_BUCKET function does not allow variables as input to the start and end time range yet, this will be addressed in a separate PR.

issue.title: ESQL: BUCKET: allow numerical spans as whole numbers

labels.name: Team:Analytics
labels.description: Meta label for analytical engine team (ESQL/Aggs/Geo)

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
This laxes the check on numerical spans to allow them be specified as whole numbers. So far it was required that they be provided as a double.

This also expands the tests for date ranges to include string types.

Resolves #109340, resolves #104646, resolves #105375.
